title: Replicating Emergent Misalignment Evaluation on Non-Harmful TruthfulQA False Statements

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Profound theoretical implication: if harmless falsehoods induce misalignment, the mechanism is deeper than 'harmful content triggers harmful generalization.' Would show any deviation from honesty creates risk. Connects to alignment of honesty and values at a fundamental level.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires constructing a TruthfulQA-based fine-tuning dataset where the model asserts wrong answers as true. The Model Organisms codebase helps but dataset construction for this specific condition needs care. SFT on 7B is feasible. Moderate difficulty for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single condition to test (TruthfulQA false statements), with comparison to existing published results for code/medical triggers. One fine-tuning run plus evaluation. Clear deliverable: misalignment rate from a truthfulness-violation trigger.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
